common.titulo_pagina: MV SearchCostumer AI · Find your next customers
common.sin_datos: Nothing here yet. Start a search from “Explore”.

explorar.subtitulo: Drop your product link. The agent researches your company, finds your buyers, finds the decision makers and writes the emails. You just show up and close.
explorar.modo_llm_falta: To research with real AI, paste your Claude API key in Settings and the option appears by itself.
explorar.error: The search could not be completed
explorar.usar_video: Include my website's video in emails and on LinkedIn
explorar.ayuda_video: Leave the URLs empty to use your own site's video section, in each recipient's language. If the video lives on YouTube, Vimeo or a CDN, paste the URL for each language here.
explorar.llm_esperando: AI research queries Claude several times and takes 1–3 minutes. Keep the tab open: the result shows up on its own when it finishes.
explorar.cupo_restante: Free web tier: {{quedan}} of {{total}} real searches left (the demo doesn't count).
explorar.cupo_agotado: The {{total}} free real web searches are used up. The demo stays free.
explorar.cupo_clave_propia: You're using your own AI key: no search limit and no email needed.

decisores.sin_correo: No email: this is a real company and we don't make up mailboxes. Find the person on LinkedIn and fill it in.
decisores.gente_linkedin: Current people at the company on LinkedIn →

correos.subtitulo: A first touch and its follow-up per company, each in the language of the recipient's country.
correos.sin_destinatario: No recipient yet: fill in the real email once you find the person
correos.adjunto_grande: Attachments can't exceed 5 MB. A video works better as a link (it already travels inside the email).
correos.smtp_falta: To actually send, set up your mailbox (SMTP) in Settings.
correos.destino_sintetico: This mailbox is synthetic (demo company): don't send as-is, replace it with a real email.

historial.subtitulo: Every search saved on this device.

config.subtitulo: Interface language, server and product details.
config.servidor_ayuda: The Android app comes connected to the public site (mv-cliente-ia.vercel.app) out of the box. If you have your own server on the LAN (or the engine running on your PC), put its address here — for example http://192.168.1.10:8810. Leave it empty on web and on the desktop app.
config.endpoint_ayuda: Corporate Copilot runs on Azure OpenAI and has no fixed URL: paste your deployment's full URL (chat/completions with api-version). The key travels as the api-key header.
config.modelo_ayuda: {{n}} models available with this key. A smaller model uses fewer tokens (and less money) per search; a bigger one thinks better but is slower and costs more.
config.modelo_sin_lista: Paste your key and press "Refresh" to fetch the models you can use with it today.
config.clave_ayuda: Pick the provider and paste your key: Claude at console.anthropic.com, ChatGPT at platform.openai.com, Gemini at aistudio.google.com, Grok at console.x.ai, and Copilot with your Azure OpenAI resource key. It's stored only in this browser and travels only when you launch an AI search: the server uses it and discards it, never stores it. With the key in place, the "AI research" option shows up in Explore.
config.smtp_ayuda: With your corporate or personal mailbox, emails go out for real and in your name. On Gmail: enable 2-step verification and create an «app password» (myaccount.google.com/apppasswords) — your regular password won't work. Credentials live in this browser; the server uses them per send and discards them.
config.owner_ayuda: Deployment owner only: if it matches the server's MVCLIENTE_OWNER variable, this browser is exempt from the free web quota.
config.x_ayuda: So that “Automate flow” can publish the campaign post on your X account. The four keys come from developer.x.com (an app with write permission). They stay in this browser and travel only with the request that uses them: the server never stores them.
config.x_guardado: X keys saved in this browser.
config.li_ayuda: LinkedIn offers no public API for sending messages or invitations: its Messages API is partner-only. The bots that message you use session-based tools. Here we talk to the provider you hire (Unipile), with YOUR key: this product never handles or stores your LinkedIn session.
config.li_riesgo: Automating LinkedIn goes against its User Agreement and can get your account restricted or closed. It's your account and your call: go slow, few messages a day, and never with the company's main account.
config.li_guardado: LinkedIn provider saved in this browser.
config.lic_activada: Licence activated. Real searches are unlocked.
config.lic_ayuda: The key arrives by email with your purchase. Paste it once and it stays saved on this computer.
config.lic_owner_nota: This copy is the owner edition: no key, no expiry.
config.licencia_ayuda: If you bought the program, paste the key you received here: the Android app and the web get unlimited searches, same as the desktop app. It stays on this device only and travels with each search; the server verifies its signature.

aviso.sintetico: Demo data: the companies and people in this list are synthetic, generated to exercise the flow. Switch the data source to “Read my real website” or “AI research” to work with real information.
aviso.avisos_corrida: The search finished, but some AI phases failed and were covered with synthetic data:

analisis.subtitulo: Success probability, market potential, SWOT of the real competition and projected profitability — from your numbers, nothing made up.
analisis.moneda: All amounts in the same currency (whichever you use in your business). The projection comes ONLY from these numbers.
analisis.sin_clave: The qualitative analysis (success, market, SWOT) uses AI with your key: paste it in Settings. The financial projection below works anyway — it's math over your numbers.
analisis.sin_equilibrio: It doesn't break even within 24 months with these numbers.
analisis.supuestos: Declared assumptions: the pessimistic scenario acquires half the customers and churns 1.5× more; the optimistic one acquires 1.5× and churns 0.7×. With ads, ad spend ÷ CAC extra customers join per month.
analisis.sin_movimiento: Heads up: with no current customers, no new customers per month and no ads (with a CAC), the projection is guaranteed zero. Fill in at least one way customers come in.
analisis.prefill_precio: The price was read from your website — fix it if it's not the real one.
analisis.prefill_clientes: New customers per month are estimated from your {{n}} prospects at a typical 3% conversion (≈ {{est}}/month) — replace with your real data if you have it.

auto.ayuda: Two independent sends, each with its own button: emails go out through your mail server and messages through your LinkedIn account. Both carry each contact's personalised message, the video, the product image and the link to request a demo. Instagram and TikTok sell no sending API: they stay queued to post by hand — nothing here is simulated.
auto.linea_correos: {{n}} emails through your SMTP, each in the recipient's language
auto.linea_x: Publish the campaign post on X (with your API keys)
auto.x_faltan_claves: Publish on X — paste your API keys in Settings
auto.linea_manuales: queued for manual posting (no sending API)
auto.confirmar: Approve the flow? {{n}} emails go out now and the receipt lands in your inbox.
auto.comprobante_fallo: The batch went out but the receipt didn't: check your SMTP
auto.li_falta_proveedor: LinkedIn — set up your provider in Settings
auto.confirmar_correo: {{n}} emails go out now, each in the recipient's language. Go ahead?
auto.confirmar_li: {{n}} messages go out from your LinkedIn account. Go ahead?
auto.li_sin_perfiles: No contact has a personal LinkedIn profile (/in/…): there's nobody to message.
auto.sin_smtp_comprobante: It was sent, but the receipt didn't go out: no mail server configured.
auto.lleva: Every message carries: personalised text · video · product image · link to request a demo

metricas.subtitulo: Conversion by segment, channel, day and hour from the backend; below, this device's send history.
metricas.vacio: You haven't automated a flow yet. Once you do it from “Emails”, this is where each channel's results show up.
metricas.confirmar_borrar: Clear all send history from this device? This can't be undone.
metricas.x_falta: To see impressions and likes, paste your X API keys in Settings.
metricas.junta_mas: Gather more sends and conversions to see which segment, day and hour perform best.
metricas.de_los_que_abrieron: of those who opened the email
metricas.aviso_apertura: Opens are measured with a pixel: they only count if the mail client loads images. Outlook blocks them by default (those opens are invisible) and Gmail preloads them (some count without anyone reading). Use it to compare segments, subject lines and times against each other — not as an absolute number.

busquedas.titulo: Find more customers in this segment
busquedas.ayuda: Ready-made queries for each network, built from the words measured on your site, the campaign's industry and its country. They are searches, not lists: LinkedIn and Instagram don't allow profile extraction, so what gets automated is writing the right query.

competencia.afinidad_ayuda: MEASURED affinity: the competitor's site was read and compared to yours.
competencia.solapamiento_ayuda: Overlap as declared by the analysis.

panel.subtitulo: Sales, revenue and downloads. The numbers come from MercadoPago and GitHub, not from a counter of our own.
panel.sin_codigo: Set your owner code in Settings to see this dashboard.
panel.hay_mas: There are more payments than fit on one page: totals cover the latest 100.
panel.traqueo_apagado: Tracking is off: without MVCLIENTE_TRAQUEO_SECRETO and MVCLIENTE_URL_TRAQUEO there is no pixel and no redirect, so opens and clicks read zero because nothing is measured — not because nothing happens.
